From the grill

Photos from the shop’s own Google listing.

The corner in the old city

Takis Kebab House stands on the corner of Nikolaou Rossou street in the old city of Larnaca, under two signs and an awning that carries the Greek name and the phone number. Inside, wooden chairs and an open view of the grill. The order is simple: souvlaki, sieftalies or something from the charcoal, and every plate arrives with chips, rice and salad. The appetizers come first and are on the house, that is printed on the menu. On Google, guests mention the large portions most of all, then the souvlaki, the starters and the Cypriot food.

Open every day from twelve noon until quarter to eleven at night. Eat in, take away or delivery.

What guests say

Two of 1,937 Google reviews, 4.4 stars on average.

“The location is inside the old city. They specialize in traditional kebabs and suvlaki, which we ordered. We were four people at the restaurant around 6:30 PM, sitting outside in the sea breeze. We received excellent service from the owner and his son, both of whom were very friendly. We ordered a lot of food and local beer. The food was delicious and full of flavor. The prices are reasonable. To sum up, it was a great experience. I strongly recommend TAKIS Kebab House.”
Yuval BKM · Google review
“We were out for a walk on our very first day in Cyprus, in Larnaca, looking for a quick bite as it was already quite late, when we came across this wonderful taverna. What first caught our attention was how busy it was. Full of people, with a cosy and welcoming atmosphere. Everything was excellent, from the food to the drinks and the overall vibe.”
D D · Google review
